content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are not options, digital creators face significant barriers to building functional online stores. This guide focuses on using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-9|supabase]] as the order database for your digital store, allowing you to accept crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-works-how|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-stack-started-generating-2|The Payment]]s without relying on conventional payment processors. By leveraging COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can establish a sovereign digital commerce setup that is both resilient and efficient. Let's explore how you can deploy Stack 01 or Stack 02, overcoming the hurdles of financial isolation and payment rejection.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The primary advantage of using Stack 01 or Stack 02 lies in the ownership and control you have over your digital store's infrastructure. Unlike traditional platforms that impose restrictions and fees, these stacks utilize open-source tools and decentralized payment systems. This architecture ensures that you are not reliant on third-party services that can deny access or impose unfavorable conditions, especially in regions facing financial instability. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, you host your site independently, while Supabase provides a reliable order database that scales with your needs. The integration of NOWPayments for crypto transactions ensures that you can accept payments with minimal fees, giving you the freedom to focus on your products and customers.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store with Stack 01 or Stack 02, gather the necessary resources. You will need a GitHub account for Stack 01 or a Cloudflare account for Stack 02. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend logic or Cloudflare Workers for Stack 02. Set up a Supabase account to manage your orders efficiently. Prepare your digital products for upload, ensuring they meet the specifications for delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, create a NOWPayments account to handle crypto payment processing seamlessly. With these tools in place, you are ready to embark on the deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have everything set, start by deploying your backend logic. For Stack 01, use Google Apps Script to handle order submissions and confirmations. With Stack 02, implement Cloudflare Workers to manage more complex order logic and interactions. After that, configure your NOWPayments integration by following the provided documentation. This step is crucial as it establishes the connection between your order database and payment processor, ensuring that transactions are verified and processed correctly. Finally, set up your delivery mechanism using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure customers receive their purchases promptly. This entire setup can be completed quickly, typically within 4-6 hours for Stack 01.
Ownership of your digital store means complete control over your infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After you have deployed your infrastructure and configured your payment and delivery systems, it’s time to go live. Conduct thorough tests on your setup to confirm that orders can be placed and processed without issues. Verify that NOWPayments is capturing payments correctly and that customers are receiving their digital products seamlessly. Once testing is complete, promote your digital store to your audience. Share your store link through social media or other channels to start attracting customers. Monitor your first transactions closely to ensure everything operates smoothly, making adjustments as necessary to optimize the user experience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store up and running, focus on scaling your operations. Use Supabase to analyze order data and customer interactions, allowing you to refine your offerings based on demand. Expand your product range by adding new digital goods, ensuring each addition is well-integrated into your existing infrastructure. Consider automating processes further by utilizing Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to streamline order handling and customer communications. Don't forget to leverage the resources found in The Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which provides comprehensive documentation and guides for scaling your digital commerce setup effectively. This approach will help you grow sustainably while maintaining control over your infrastructure.

Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize COREMERCH's Stack 01 or Stack 02. Host your store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, manage orders with Supabase, and process payments using NOWPayments. This setup avoids conventional payment restrictions.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages and Workers, taking 48 hours for deployment. Stack 02 offers enhanced capabilities and scalability for larger operations.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are suitable for hosting a digital product store. They provide the necessary infrastructure to deliver products efficiently while allowing you to maintain complete control over your store.
What are the costs associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction. There are no KYC requirements, and no buyer account is needed, making it an ideal solution for processing crypto payments in your digital store.
How do I ensure my digital store is secure?

To secure your digital store, implement HTTPS with Cloudflare and regularly update your backend code. Use Supabase's built-in security features to manage access to your order data, and ensure NOWPayments is configured correctly to handle transactions safely.
